output.summary: A palm tree endemic to New Zealand and the only palm native to its mainland. It has a smooth, bulging crownshaft, lilac-to-pink flowers and red ripe fruit; island forms vary, with the Chatham Islands form having larger fruit and hairier fronds.
output.edibilityNote: Māori traditionally ate inner leaf bases and young flower clusters raw or cooked, rarely harvested palm heart, and ate unripe berries; ripe berries are inedible.
